scope: H16 native residual/explicit same-position-zero observation source and durable outbox slice only

findings.issue: Latest entry-result selection prevents valid close projection after a later unchanged reconciliation of the original entry.
findings.evidence: The adapter selects the ENTRY result from recovered.current_order_results, then calls the pure close builder with the original positive source. That builder reconstructs entry basis at source_position.broker_state_observed_at; entry_observation._build_entry_projection rejects result.observed_at > that original anchor (line97). A real later reconciliation of an already-filled entry changes only its observation timestamp/current result while preserving original request/fills/quantity/average. It then blocks partial/flat close projection even though an authentic earlier entry result and complete history remain available.
findings.minimal_fix: Use the actual historical entry result bound to or consistent with the original positive source/execution basis for its reconstruction. Retain every later actual order observation in the complete final execution binding. Do not rewrite a timestamp, ignore extra fills, substitute a manufactured result or weaken original-source clock validation.
findings.minimal_regression: After actual entry publication and original close preparation/claim, reconcile the same entry again at a later clock using the same original native fill identities/times and quantity. Assert the original E5 source/action remains intact and partial then explicit same-position-zero close observations still publish/recover EXIT_REQUESTED successfully.

static_assessment: The adapter requires an issued current native read, exact original positive entry/native position ID, claimed original close role, prepared plan/action/source hashes and a complete decoded canonical graph. Unrelated exit requests/fills and residual disagreement are refused.

Partial/flat effects remain EXIT_REQUESTED, retain original first-fill/average/position identity and include every actual canonical request/result/fill in the execution binding; no provider position ID is added to the canonical projection.

The additive ProductCloseObservation audit material retains original source and predecessor projection identity. The dispatch transaction rechecks the common claim inventory generation under BEGIN IMMEDIATE, validates native/source/entry binding and monotonic newer observations, then commits one immutable bundle.

The recovery test injects failure after durable outbox commit and uses a successor dispatch lease to publish the same bundle without another HTTP request or resubmit; this is source component coverage, not installed-native evidence.
